Questions

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Do you shoot outside Kerala?

Yes. We produce across India and in the GCC, building crews locally where it makes sense.

How long does an ad film take?

Typically 3–6 weeks from approved script to final delivery, depending on the scale of the shoot and post-production.

Can you deliver all the formats we need?

Yes. We plan cut-downs and aspect ratios for TV, cinema, YouTube, Reels and Stories from the start, so everything is shot for its final use.
